summary: The candidate is a valid partial fix: it centralizes the three inherited server/unit counterexamples and its focused regression passes, but its repeated-ID guard still misses ordinary executable model fixtures. An existing cross-tree repetition of ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8 remains in server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_diffusion_bcg_padding.py, while the guard reports no finding. Independent dictionary and positional-constructor fixtures also evade the policy. The candidate therefore does not fully enforce the original common-entry contract.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, each reviewed ID occurred in both server/gpu_cases.py and an ordinary unit fixture. At the candidate commit, each occurs only in test_utils.py, confirming the inherited counterexamples were corrected.
The exact candidate's own model-name regression suite passed: 4 passed.
Directly affected unit coverage passed: 94 passed and 5 subtests passed.
Both independent contract cases failed because repeated dictionary model_path fixtures and repeated positional DiffusionServerArgs model IDs returned no guard findings.

tests.command: candidate helper over server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_diffusion_bcg_padding.py
tests.what_was_measured: The helper returned [] despite ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8 being present in both files.
The imported package resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang/__init__.py, confirming tests used checkout source.

gpu_execution.evidence: No inference or numerical implementation changed. The review exercised AST policy and affected CPU unit tests; no GPU-output claim is made.

remaining_counterexamples: The existing model ID ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8 remains hard-coded in server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_diffusion_bcg_padding.py; the candidate guard returns no finding because the unit occurrence is an assertion literal rather than a recognized resolver or named assignment.
Repeated model IDs stored as dictionary values under model_path are not recognized until separately added to the shared constant set.
Repeated model IDs passed positionally to DiffusionServerArgs are not recognized by the uncentralized-ID detector.

The blanket exemption for unit/test_server_args.py leaves executable model-selection literals outside both enforcement checks; this includes values also used outside that file, although some entries are intentional parser vectors and need a narrower classification rather than unconditional scanning.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed (the base-to-candidate native diff is empty), so a native rebuild was not applicable.
No model weights were downloaded and no model inference was run; semantic accuracy is outside this refactor's changed behavior.
Ascend and MUSA runtime paths are unavailable on this ROCm host, and the touched data-parallel serving case requires two GPUs while one GPU was assigned.
The broad literal inventory includes intentional expected-value/parser vectors and non-model slash strings; only concrete executable cross-tree examples were used for the recommendation.
